title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb kebabs marinated in traditional Middle Eastern spices and grilled to perfection. Perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, boneless and cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to cut the lamb into skewer-sized pieces.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the kebabs during grilling.

ingredients.name: garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 1 or 2 cloves depending on your taste.

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika gives a nice smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt or sea salt.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they're evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread 3-4 lamb cubes onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with the marinade and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they're cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
